title: Jeremiah Smith, Jr. Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Between 1947 and 1955, Steiner earned his Bachelor, Masters and Law Degrees at Harvard University. Before returning to the Law School in 1962 as assistant professor, he spent a year on a Traveling Fellowship granted by the Law School, a year as Law Clerk to Justice John M.
